resources.string: Lets Meow Island draw its floating island above the status bar. It does not read your screen, watch what you do, or collect any data.

Optional. Lets Meow Island count Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts and, if you turn it on, cover those two feeds with a block screen. It only looks inside Instagram and YouTube, only for the video-feed screen, and keeps nothing except your daily counts. It never reads messages, comments, passwords or anything you type, and sends nothing anywhere.
